exact_statement: For every integer m>=2, let b_m(Y)=(-1)^(sum_j Y_(2j-1)Y_(2j)) on 2m bits, G_m(w,Y,z)=b_m(Y)+1{w=0,Y=0}(z-1), c_m=b_m-2*1{w=0,Y=0}, and delta=2^(-(2m+1)). In bits, with both actual z terminals retained, D_z=H(G_m)-(H(b_m)+H(c_m))/2=B_z+JS_z and S_2=(2I(b_m)-H(b_m)+2I(c_m)-H(c_m))/2 satisfy S_2-D_z>delta/4. In particular both terminals and G_m satisfy H<=2I. For every C>=2 the same payment holds with S_C, including any independent spectator q with available H(q)<=C I(q), retaining its full terminal entropy. No assertion about arbitrary cores or already debited ancestor banks is made.
